suppression by virus of host STAT2 activity

definition: A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupt a JAK-STAT signal cascade in the host organism by reducing the activity of host STAT2 (signal transducer and activator of transcription 2).
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host JAK-STAT cascade via inhibition of STAT2 activity
